---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new capability or improvement
title: "[feat] "
labels: ["enhancement", "needs-triage"]
assignees: []
---

## Problem statement

What user or operational pain are you trying to solve? Focus on the *why*, not the *how*.

> Example: "Managers can't see which subordinates have *not yet* submitted goal sheets close to a deadline."

## Proposed solution

What you'd like to see built. UI sketches, API shape, behavior — whichever is most concrete.

## Alternatives considered

Other approaches and why they were rejected (if any).

## Impact

| Area | Notes |
|------|-------|
| Affected role(s) | Employee / Manager / Admin |
| Backend changes | (new endpoints? schema migration? events?) |
| Frontend changes | (new page? component? hook?) |
| Breaking change? | Yes / No |
| Telemetry / audit | What new audit-log actions or events would this need? |

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] …
- [ ] …
- [ ] Tests added (backend + frontend where applicable)
- [ ] Documentation updated (`Readme.md`, `docs/`)

## Additional context

Links, references, related issues, prior art.
